evaluation_limit: No accuracy claim before human labels and held-out evaluation. Unrepresented joint strata and matches outside blocking are not evaluated by this sample.
precision_policy: Unknown precision stays unknown; 10 km review candidates only.
privacy: Detailed source/pair artifacts stay local, Git-ignored and unpublished.

sampling.blocking_policy: 3D unit-sphere grid; shared pilot family; distance <= min(pair radii)
sampling.name_category_policy: Exact normalized aliases, multiple/one/no shared name tokens, or missing names; these are sampling categories, not match scores or predicted labels.
sampling.sampling_method: marginal coverage then square-root stratum quotas; seeded hash order
sampling.weight_definition: candidate_count / sample_quota within each sampled joint stratum
sampling.weight_limit: Unsampled joint strata have null weights. Weights describe this review design; they do not establish population precision or recall.

scope: Deposit and explicit mine points only; exclusions preserve original pilot rows.
